thread:
Sam R: Deploy finished for optimize-v2 -> prod-usw2. deploy-bot shows all hosts updated. Starting post-release verification — mirroring 1% traffic to the canary cohort. tagging @Tia N and @Leo (oncall) to watch.
deploy-bot: POST-DEPLOY VERIFY: canary_cohort=1% | checks=[health,latency,error_rate,synthetic] | summary: health=OK, error_rate=0.12%, p95=82ms, synthetic/hello-gen=PASS
Tia N: I'm seeing a tiny spike of 502/503s on the rerank route in the last 90s, ~2 failures out of ~200 mirrored reqs. Not sure if transient. Pulling logs now.
Leo (oncall): grabbing logs. quick grep showed upstream timeouts from inference-worker-004 around 14:03:22Z. snippet:

```
[2026-03-21T14:03:22Z] inference-worker-004 ERROR upstream timeout id=abc123 route=rerank size=5120ms
[2026-03-21T14:03:22Z] routing-proxy WARN request-id=abc123 status=502
```

Leo (oncall): I bumped canary throttle to 0.5% and enabled soft-fallback -> baseline-model v1-quant for rerank-route so callers will get the safe path on error. Also increased retry_budget for proxy to 3.
Sam R: Thanks. Can we add sampling for failing traces (x-request-id) and attach them to the rollout ticket? Also create an alert if error_rate > 1% over 3m or p95 > 250ms.
Nick P: Agree. My call: hold the rollout at 0.5% mirror for 30m. If error_rate > 1% or sustained p95 > 250ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows, we rollback to v1. I'll make the rollback ticket and pre-fill the runbook steps.
Amara (PM): Filing a short customer-facing note in the release doc: mention a brief performance tuning window and that we're monitoring; draft posted in the release notes channel in 15. Also flag any incidents for customers if we escalate.
Tia N: With the soft-fallback on, most production traffic unaffected. I'll re-run the post-deploy synthetic suite with added rerank-heavy prompts (100q) every 5m to surface more issues.
Sam R: Plan: hold rollout at 0.5% mirror, collect failed traces, run synthetic rerank sweeps every 5m, alerts as Nick described. If thresholds crossed -> immediate rollback using ticket #RL-6887. If stable after 30m, we'll ramp to 5% then 25% per normal cadence.
deploy-bot: MONITORING NOTE: alert created: deploy/optimize-v2/prod-usw2/error_rate >1% (3m) -> paging policy=oncall; dashboard: https://internal.metrics/services/optimize-v2?from=now-1h | rollback_ticket=RL-6887
Tia N: :thumbsup: I'll watch the synthetic runs and post updates here. If I see repeat 502s I'll trigger the rollback immediately.
Leo (oncall): I put a short-term allocation increase on inference-worker pool (extra 2 replicas) to reduce tail latency while we triage.
Sam R: Thanks everyone — standing by. I'll update the release notes with the holdpoint and link to the runbook. Leaving this thread open for 30m then closing with final decision.
